facts.text: Deer Park began as a 1860s stagecoach stop between Calistoga and Napa Valley, later becoming a San Francisco elite retreat thanks to its hot springs.
Perched on Howell Mountain’s eastern slopes at about 568 feet, Deer Park overlooks the Napa Valley floor to the southwest.
Schramsberg Vineyards, founded in 1862, is one of California’s oldest sparkling wine producers and famously supplied wine for Nixon’s 1972 China summit.
Mixed oak savanna and chaparral across Deer Park shape microclimates that nurture boutique vineyards of Cabernet Sauvignon and Bordeaux blends.
In August 2020, Deer Park was evacuated as the Hennessey Fire, part of the LNU Lightning Complex, scorched over 315,000 acres.
The Glass Fire in September 2020 destroyed numerous homes and much of Foothills Adventist Elementary School, sparking extensive recovery efforts.
